info.name: OpenCanvas
info.summary: Collaborative canvases: documents, databases and whiteboards in one file
info.description:
Create .ocanvas files in Files and edit them together in real time with OpenCanvas. One canvas holds rich text, databases (table, board, calendar views) and whiteboards side by side. Requires a running OpenCanvas server; Nextcloud keeps the files, permissions and versions.
